title: Regional Evacuation Routing with Tiered Throttles and Safe Model Demotion
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a region-evacuation routing policy that gracefully redirects traffic off overloaded or degraded regional Dedicated pools into safe hosted alternatives while applying tier-aware throttles and an automated, auditable model-variant demotion path. Goal: keep tail latency and error rates within SLOs during regional incidents without causing cascading capacity pressure in hosted or other regions.
acceptance_criteria: Policy can detect regional degradation signals (latency P95 > threshold, error rate spike, capacity pressure) and trigger an evacuation window for affected tenants
Evacuation applies tiered throttles (tiered rate reductions + soft-queueing) respecting reserved capacity for Dedicated contracts
Automated variant demotion matrix can switch tenants to lower-cost/compatible model variants with rollback and cooldown windows
Routing decisions are observable in Console with per-tenant decision traces, emitted events, and a dashboard showing SLO impact and traffic shifts
Runbook documented and validated by on-call with a non-production canary and a staged production rollout
design_notes: Evacuation is a four-phase flow: detect -> isolate -> redirect -> demote/restore
Signals: backend latency distribution, GPU utilization, queue depth, per-tenant error rate, and cross-region link health

Tiered throttles: Tier 0 (enterprise SLA) 100% preserved unless manual override; Tier 1 (committed but flexible) soft-throttle (10-50%) + short queueing; Tier 2 (best-effort) bulk redirect with immediate demotion option
Demotion matrix: map exact model variants by compatibility and expected degradation (e.g., rdx-large-fp16 -> rdx-medium-int8), include estimated quality delta and token-cost delta
Grace periods: pre-evacuation warmup of KV caches via sampled prefetches; post-evacuation cooldown and telemetry collection for 30 min
Safety: global hosted ingress cap to avoid creating a cascading overload; tenant-level circuit-breaker with backoff and exponential retries
Decision determinism: include stable hashing for region selection + versioned policy config stored in CP to ensure reproducible routing across brokers
implementation_notes: Controller: new EvacuationController in route-orchestrator service that subscribes to region health events from telemetry and capacity manager
Policy config: CRD-like JSON stored in control-plane (keys: detection_windows, thresholds, tier_policies, variant_map, global_caps)
Routing path changes: small header flag (X-Rd-Evacuation) to mark redirected requests and preserve observability across proxies
KV-cache warming: implemented as sampled prefix replays routed to hosted to seed caches before full redirect
Telemetry: emit evacuation_start/evacuation_end events with tenant, region, tier, and routed_variant fields; expose Grafana dashboard and Console panel
Compatibility checks: runtime will validate variant compatibility (vocab, tokenizer) before demotion; if incompatible, fall back to rate-limiting/queued processing
Backpressure: hosted ingress limiter will maintain a reserved slack for emergency redirects (configurable per-region)
Testing: add unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests with local simulated capacity stress, and e2e with synthetic tenants
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag behind 'evacuation-routing' in control plane (disabled by default)
2) Internal canary: enable for infra-testing tenant in staging; validate KV warming and metrics
3) Pilot: enable for two low-risk tenants in us-west with monitoring and on-call runbook
4) Gradual ramp: add Tier 2 tenants across regions; monitor hosted capacity and adjust global_caps
5) Full: enable automatic detection for all non-enterprise tenants; enterprise preserved by default and requires manual opt-in
6) Post-rollout: 2-week observation window, iterate on thresholds and demotion mapping
tests: Signal injection harness to simulate latency spikes and capacity exhaustion in a region
Load test that verifies hosted global_caps prevent more than X% of traffic being redirected simultaneously
Quality regression suite that measures deltas when demoting from each primary model to its mapped variant
Chaos runbook rehearse: on-call executes manual evacuation and measures time-to-stabilize
